messages:
Alex: heads-up: we plan a gradual rollforward for feature_flag=llm_route_v2 during the 01:30 PT change window. goal: 5% traffic, keep blast radius tiny.
Simone: 01:30 PT ok. what's the exact cohort split?
Alex: plan: 1% internal canary, 2% beta customers, 2% random external. all pinned to model v2.1 for canary route.
Ravi: confirm no DB/schema. also want explicit shard targeting so GPUs aren't overloaded.
Noor: will pin canary to shard-7 and limit concurrency to 8 per shard for canary.
Alex: health gates we'll use: errors > 0.7% OR p99 latency > baseline*1.2 -> immediate hold. sustained mem pressure > 70% for 5m -> fallback.
Simone: add quality gate: automated rouge/coverage check on 50 golden prompts; >5% quality drop -> rollback.
Ravi: rollback and fast-disable commands in one place please — oncall should not guess.
Noor: adding runbook snippet:

```
# fast-disable flag
POST https://controlplane.redwood/api/v1/flags/llm_route_v2/disable
Authorization: Bearer $DEPLOY_TOKEN

# pin route back to v2.0
POST https://controlplane.redwood/api/v1/routes/pin
Body: {"service":"inference","model_version":"v2.0","force":true}

# deploy-bot alias
deploy-bot rollback 6283749100 --fast
```

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled by Alex at 2026-05-10T01:30:00-07:00. job=6283749. notify=@infra-oncall.
infra-oncall: acknowledged. I'll be watching infra metrics. escalation path: infra-lead -> eng-manager.
Alex: note: canary will have `max_tokens=384` and `sampling_temp=0.8` overrides to limit cost and surface regressions.
Simone: any fallback routing? if eu region overloaded we should prefer us fallback, not drop to older model globally.
Noor: routing policy: region-fallback list configured (eu->us->fallback-v2.0). will enforce sticky sessions for pinned users.
Ravi: telemetry to monitor: request_failures, generation_retries, p99_latency, gpu_util, token_bill_rate. set alerts: failures >= 3x baseline for 2m OR p99 >= baseline*1.25 for 1m.
Simone: I'll prepare a small smoke script to run against canary cohort (curl + simple prompts). posting link in release notes.
Alex: release notes draft to paste in channels:
- rollout: llm_route_v2 -> v2.1 (pinned canary)
- cohorts: 1% internal, 2% beta, 2% external
- overrides: max_tokens=384, sampling_temp=0.8
- health gates: errors>0.7% | p99>20% | quality drop>5% -> hold/rollback
- runbook: disable + pin + deploy-bot rollback alias
Link: https://confluence.redwood/releases/rollforward-6283749
Ravi: who triggers hold vs who runs rollback?
infra-oncall: primary oncall holds and runs fast-disable. notify eng-releases lead for a second confirmation before full rollback to v2.0.
Simone: add quick checklist for oncall in thread final message so it's easy to copy.
Noor: checklist:
- run quick smoke harness for 5 golden prompts
- check p99, errors, gpu mem on shard-7
- if any gate tripped: run `deploy-bot rollback 6283749100 --fast` then post status in #incidents and this thread
- escalate to infra-lead if unsure

deploy-bot: reminder 15m before change: job=6283749 starts in 15 minutes.
Alex: final rule: any one engineer can start rollback if they observe gate breach and can verify. don't wait for consensus.
Simone: noted. I'll post dashboard link and smoke harness: https://console.redwood/dashboards/llm_route_v2_canary and https://git.redwood/infra/rollouts/smoke-harness
Ravi: ready to go. I'll monitor GPU and token-cost graphs.
deploy-bot: job=6283749 started at 2026-05-10T01:30:00-07:00. canary: internal 1% applied.
Simone: internal smoke run green +3m.
infra-oncall: infra looks stable. p99 +4%, errors unchanged. gpu mem healthy.
Noor: beta cohort (2%) applied. concurrency limit in effect.
Ravi: seeing small qps shift to shard-7, util ~62%.
Simone: golden prompts pass thresholds. no quality regression spotted.
Alex: holding initial 10m soak.
Noor: external 2% applied. token bill spike +12% but expected.
infra-oncall: alert: sustained p99 at +22% for 90s. watching closely.
Simone: re-running golden prompts now.
Ravi: gpu mem creeping up but <70%.
Simone: golden rechecks still within bounds. false alarm?
infra-oncall: p99 dropped back under threshold. no action unless it sustains 2m.
Alex: keep monitoring. if it resurges, pull the trigger.
Noor: no further anomalies. leaving concurrency cap in place.
deploy-bot: job=6283749 completed: rollout at 5% applied.
Alex: publishing final release note and closing runbook action items. schedule 48h cost review.
Simone: thanks all. will follow up with a short summary in #eng-releases and schedule retrospective if any rollback occurs.
Ravi: logging action to evaluate per-region unit economics.
Noor: runbook saved in confluence and linked from dashboard.
Alex: good job team. will close thread after 24h if no regressions. :rocket:
